# DiffFind

> AI Document & Text Comparison. See what changed — and understand what it means. DiffFind combines deterministic lexical comparison with AI-powered semantic analysis to compare text, documents, PDFs, structured data, and API requests. Deterministic comparison shows what changed; AI helps explain what it means.

## Compare
- [AI Document Comparison](https://difffind.com/document-compare/): compare documents with AI
- [Text Compare](https://difffind.com/text-compare/): AI text comparison and text diff
- [Semantic Diff](https://difffind.com/semantic-diff/): AI diff tool that compares meaning
- [PDF Comparison](https://difffind.com/pdf-compare/)
- [Word Comparison](https://difffind.com/word-compare/): compare two Word (.docx) documents
- [Excel Comparison](https://difffind.com/excel-compare/): XLS and XLSX
- [JSON Compare](https://difffind.com/json-compare/), [YAML Compare](https://difffind.com/yaml-compare/), [CSV Compare](https://difffind.com/csv-compare/)
- [XML Compare](https://difffind.com/xml-compare/): compare two XML files
- [API Compare](https://difffind.com/api-compare/)
- [URL Compare](https://difffind.com/url-compare/): compare content from two URLs
- [cURL Compare](https://difffind.com/curl-compare/): compare two cURL commands and their API responses

## Semantic Find (search by meaning)
- [Semantic Search](https://difffind.com/semantic-search/)
- [Semantic Document Search](https://difffind.com/semantic-document-search/)

## More
- [Diffchecker Alternative](https://difffind.com/diffchecker-alternative/)
- [DiffFind Launcher Chrome extension](https://difffind.com/chrome-extension/)
- [DiffFind Desktop](https://difffind.com/desktop/): local desktop app for macOS and Windows free to use
- [Download DiffFind Desktop](https://difffind.com/desktop/download/)
- [OpenAPI specification](https://app.difffind.com/openapi.json)
